import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def main():
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    P = int(data[2])
    maxn = n + 1

    def fpow(x, k):
        ans = 1
        base = x
        while k:
            if k & 1:
                ans = ans * base % P
            base = base * base % P
            k >>= 1
        return ans

    def C(x, y):
        if x < y:
            return 0
        return fac[x] * inv[y] % P * inv[x - y] % P

    def S(x):
        return x * (x + 1) // 2

    fac = [1] * (maxn + 1)
    inv = [1] * (maxn + 1)
    for i in range(1, maxn + 1):
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % P
    for i in range(1, maxn + 1):
        inv[i] = fpow(fac[i], P - 2)

    f = [0] * (m + 1)
    g = [0] * (m + 1)
    f[0] = 1

    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(i):
            f[i] = (f[i] + f[j] * f[i - 1 - j] % P * C(i - 1, j) % P) % P
            g[i] = (g[i] + ((g[j] * f[i - 1 - j] % P + f[j] * g[i - 1 - j] % P) * (i + 1) % P + f[j] * f[i - 1 - j] % P * (S(j) + S(i - 1 - j)) % P) * C(i - 1, j) % P) % P
        f[i] = f[i] * (i + 1) % P

    F = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    G = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
    F[0][0] = 1
    for j in range(n + 1):
        F[0][j] = 1

    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        F[i][i] = f[i]
        G[i][i] = g[i]
        for j in range(i + 1, n + 1):
            F[i][j] = F[i][j - 1]
            G[i][j] = G[i][j - 1]
            for l in range(1, i + 1):
                F[i][j] = (F[i][j] + F[i - l][j - 1 - l] * f[l] % P * C(i, l) % P) % P
                G[i][j] = (G[i][j] + (G[i - l][j - 1 - l] * f[l] % P + F[i - l][j - 1 - l] * g[l] % P) * C(i, l) % P) % P

    print(G[m][n])

if __name__ == "__main__":
